title: Alignment stage idles about 7% of thread time
body:
On the mgy run the alignment branch reports 93.0% busy over 175.7 s at 48 threads. That is about 12 s of idle thread time, more than any serial item except the db write. The likely cause is imbalance at the tail. `search.rs` runs `par_chunks(100)` over seeds grouped by query, and threads wait while the last chunks finish.

## Proposal

Measure busy time against chunk size before changing anything. Smaller chunks, or seeds from different queries interleaved, would recover part of the idle time.

## Open

- This needs the 48-thread box.
close_reason: The idle is gone at bb3c392. A rerun of 432ff65 reproduced 93.1% busy, and bb3c392 runs 99.6% busy on the same inputs and flags. Numbers in note f3b56c9f.

notes.author: jackroddy/4125deb5
notes.text:
On the 48-thread box, `catalyst`, the idle reproduces at `432ff65` and is gone at `bb3c392`. Both runs were pinned to the 48 physical cores of NUMA node 0 at `-t 48`, with the flags `stage-times` passes: `-E 10 --mmseqs-s 12.0 --seed-mode prog -s`. The inputs were the `mgy` part of the `stage-times` set, 20,795 Pfam profiles against 2,455,940 MGnify targets.

| commit | alignment wall, s | cpu, s | busy |
|---|---|---|---|
| `432ff65`, this issue's run | 175.71 | 7,842.90 | 93.0% |
| `432ff65`, rerun | 172.28 | 7,699.14 | 93.1% |
| `bb3c392` | 160.71 | 7,685.28 | 99.6% |

The two reruns do the same cpu work within 0.2%. At `bb3c392` that work finishes 11.6 s sooner, so the threads stop idling. Nothing is left for this issue to recover at `dev`.

The logs are in `tmp-claude/2026-10-18-serial-overhead-48t/repro-432ff65` and `full-s12` on `catalyst`.
